title: Cardinality of the odd frequency extension
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $m$ and a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, form the family of sets obtained by adjoining $i$ to each $m$-element subset of the other $n-1$ coordinates. This family has cardinality $\binom{n-1}{m}$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
